title: Toss It High
blurb: Every yusheng ingredient carries a wish. Match them up.
fact: Yu (fish) sounds like the word for abundance, and sheng (raw) also means growth, so the dish's name is itself a wish. The higher you toss, the greater your fortune.
credit: Facts from the National Heritage Board's Roots entry on yusheng and lo hei. Text and art are original.

content.prompt: Tap an ingredient, then tap the wish it carries.

pairs.b: Blessings for everyone at the table
